domain_name: Data Engineering, Big Data & Knowledge Intelligence
description: High-throughput streaming, Lakehouse storage (Iceberg/Delta), vector/graph databases, and data mesh.

stream_processing.name: Data Ingestion & Real-Time Event Streaming
stream_processing.description: High-throughput messaging (Kafka, Redpanda), stream processing (Flink, Spark), and exactly-once semantics.

lakehouse_warehousing.name: Data Warehousing & Lakehouse Platforms
lakehouse_warehousing.description: Modern cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse) and open table formats (Iceberg, Delta).

data_orchestration.name: Data Transformation, DAGs & Quality
data_orchestration.description: dbt modeling, Airflow/Dagster orchestration, data lineage tracking, and automated data quality tests.

specialized_databases.name: Specialized Databases (Vector, Graph & Time-Series)
specialized_databases.description: Vector indexing for AI (Milvus, Qdrant), graph relationships (Neo4j), and time-series metrics.

data_mesh_governance.name: Data Mesh, Semantics & Governance
data_mesh_governance.description: Domain-oriented decentralized data products, semantic layers, and enterprise data cataloging.

product_manager.domain_objectives: Define data freshness SLAs, business KPI definitions, data lineage visibility, and data consumer requirements.
product_manager.requirements_rubric: Data contract specifications, downstream analytical query requirements, data retention policies, and schema evolution plans.
forbidden_pitfalls: Untracked schema drift breaking downstream consumers

system_architect.role_title: Chief Data Architect & Distributed Storage Lead
system_architect.domain_objectives: Architect scalable data pipelines, Lakehouse table partitioning, schema registries, and idempotent backfill pipelines.
performance_invariants: Zero data loss on consumer restart

adversarial_sdet.role_title: Lead Data Quality & Pipeline Verification SDET
adversarial_sdet.threat_model: Schema drift, duplicate messages, out-of-order event streams, data corruption, backpressure deadlock.
adversarial_sdet.boundary_fuzzing: Probe pipelines with null timestamps, unexpected string characters in numeric columns, and duplicate UUIDs.

core_engineer.coding_idioms: Vectorized SQL transformations, idempotent MERGE statements, clean PySpark/Flink code, explicit type casting.
core_engineer.concurrency_rules: Distributed partitioning, checkpointing state, non-blocking asynchronous stream consumption.
core_engineer.memory_and_resource_rules: Memory-efficient streaming buffers, zero out-of-memory errors on large batch joins, spilling to disk optimization.

technical_writer.documentation_lexicon: Data dictionaries, entity relationship diagrams (ERD), lineage graphs, and pipeline SLAs.
technical_writer.architectural_diagram_style: Medallion data architecture flows, Kafka event topologies, and Lakehouse table schemas.
